data.name: Voyage Senki VR 海洋传说 VR
data.detailed_description:
Notice about Server Closing Temporaily

Dear Users:
Thanks for your support of VR game.
We will close our service temporaily as we are rewrite our basic server program， so that we can update our game content and experience.
The plan will take about 6 months, and during the time, our users can't login game.
We will open our game when we finish the updating program.
Sorry about the inconvenience for all of our users, and many thanks for your understanding.

Voyage Senki VR developing team.






Voyage Senki is one VR online game. The game choose sailing and sea warfare as the theme. Players in game will build the battle ships, recruit sailors and explore the unknown world to set up a new country of their own. The present version includes three contents: SLG model with the island raid, PVP model for 3 vs 3 team players, and story model demo.

PVE
Island raid
Player can send fleet, hero, and troops to raid the target island.
Goal: to destroy the base of privates or other players. You need to steer your battle ship and head the troops to attack the defence and base, try to destroy as many target as possible to get more loot or rewards in game









PVP：Sea warfare for team battle (3 vs 3)

Player can choose different types of battle ship to join the team battle. You will match with other two players in one team and battle with the opponent team. Destroy the ships and defence tower of the opponent will get score and resources as reward. Different ship types need to match proper skills to get the maximum of capacity. And you can make a various formation of team fleet with your teammates.










Story Model
Player in story model will follow the story of treasure hunting including searching maps, complete missions and defeat the monsters or privates in game to get loot and rewards.





Features

1， HD graphics
With Unreal 4 engine, the graphics in game has perfect HD quality for VR. In story model you may feel like a in a movie and you are the leading actor/actress in it.

2, Weather system
Weather system has been set in game. Drizzling rain, snowfall, beautiful dawn and lovely sunset viewing, all make the VR world to be like a real one.

3, Free movement in game
The ships can be controlled by the controllers, and player don’t need move body in large scale. Seating or standing and with your controllers, you can steer the ship in the game world everywhere.

4, OB(observer) model for game live streaming.

We provide OB model for streamers who like to stream our VR game. OB model can provide more broad views for visitor, the streamer need not to have a VR set at first. With the OB model, streamer can change cameras and show the battle in all directional.

Pls noticed: OB model need streamer to send an application to official to get it. We will send details requirement of applicant, and how to apply it soon.

reviews.review:
Voyage Senki VR 海洋传说 VR is an ambitious virtual reality naval adventure that combines maritime exploration, strategic combat, and multiplayer warfare into an experience centered on commanding ships and conquering the seas. Developed by Shanghai Superpoint Technology Co., Ltd. and published by Shandong Qianbei Technology Co. Ltd., this free-to-play title attempts to immerse players in a world of naval expeditions, territorial expansion, and tactical battles. Its combination of strategy, role-playing elements, and VR interaction offers an interesting premise, although its execution and uncertain online accessibility considerably diminish its overall appeal.

The game's central concept involves building warships, recruiting sailors, organizing military forces, and exploring unfamiliar waters while working toward establishing a maritime nation. This combination of naval management and exploration creates the foundation for a potentially rewarding progression system. Rather than focusing entirely on direct combat, the experience encourages players to consider fleet composition, territorial objectives, and resource acquisition. However, the available description provides limited information about the depth of its construction and nation-building mechanics, leaving some uncertainty about how extensively these systems are developed.

One of its primary gameplay modes revolves around attacking enemy-controlled islands. Players can deploy fleets, heroes, and troops to assault defensive positions, destroy hostile installations, and acquire valuable rewards. These encounters combine ship navigation with military strategy, offering opportunities to coordinate attacks against fortified locations. The inclusion of multiple combat units adds variety to the concept, although the actual effectiveness of these mechanics depends on enemy intelligence, mission diversity, and responsive controls. Repeated island assaults could become repetitive without sufficiently varied objectives or tactical challenges.

Competitive multiplayer introduces three-versus-three naval battles where players select different warships and cooperate against opposing teams. Victory involves destroying enemy vessels and defensive towers while earning points and resources. Different ship types are designed to benefit from suitable skills and complementary fleet formations, encouraging teamwork rather than relying exclusively on individual performance. This structure has the potential to deliver engaging tactical encounters, particularly when players coordinate their attacks and defensive maneuvers. Unfortunately, its reliance on active online services makes multiplayer accessibility a significant concern.

The story component offers a more adventure-oriented experience involving treasure hunting, map exploration, mission completion, and battles against monsters and pirates. This mode provides an appealing alternative to competitive warfare by emphasizing discovery and progression. Searching for hidden treasures while navigating dangerous waters fits naturally within the maritime setting. However, the story content is identified as a demonstration rather than a complete campaign, suggesting that players should approach its narrative ambitions with modest expectations.

Visually, the game utilizes Unreal Engine 4 to create its ocean environments and virtual reality presentation. Its maritime setting provides opportunities for atmospheric scenery, particularly through the inclusion of changing weather conditions such as rainfall, snowfall, sunrise, and sunset. These environmental details can strengthen immersion and make exploration more visually interesting. Nevertheless, the description does not establish whether weather influences navigation or combat, suggesting that its primary contribution may be aesthetic rather than mechanical.

The control system supports tracked VR controllers and allows players to navigate ships while seated or standing. This accessibility consideration is particularly appropriate for naval gameplay, where commanding a vessel does not necessarily require extensive physical movement. An additional observer mode is advertised for livestreamers, offering alternative camera perspectives for spectators. However, access to this feature requires an application, and its current availability remains uncertain.

Despite its promising ideas, the game's most substantial weakness concerns its online infrastructure. The Steam description prominently displays a notice explaining that servers were temporarily closed for redevelopment, preventing players from logging in during the maintenance period. No confirmed restoration of service is established by the available information. This uncertainty is particularly damaging because the game depends heavily on online functionality. Its Mixed Steam reception, with approximately 53% positive feedback from 47 reviews, further suggests that its overall reception has been inconsistent.

Steam Deck compatibility is officially classified as Unsupported. Voyage Senki VR requires dedicated PC virtual reality hardware, compatible motion controllers, and SteamVR or Oculus PC support. Since the Steam Deck does not natively support VR gaming, the title is unsuitable for conventional handheld gameplay. Players interested in experiencing it should instead use a compatible Windows gaming computer equipped with the necessary VR equipment.

Ultimately, Voyage Senki VR presents an intriguing combination of naval strategy, island conquest, cooperative warfare, and treasure-hunting adventures. Its ambitious design and atmospheric setting offer genuine conceptual appeal, particularly for enthusiasts seeking unusual virtual reality experiences. However, limited demonstrated content, uncertain server functionality, and dependence on specialized hardware make it difficult to recommend confidently. While its free-to-play model removes the initial financial barrier, accessibility and long-term playability remain serious concerns.

A promising but underdeveloped VR naval adventure with interesting strategic concepts, weakened by uncertain online availability, limited content, and substantial accessibility restrictions.

Rating: 5/10
